text:
marta_docs: Quick heads-up: after yesterday's header tidy we got a failing link-check on several internal anchors under /docs/sdk/python. Not blocking deploys but noisy during CI.

link-scan-bot: link-scan: 5 broken anchors detected in /docs/sdk/python -> https://scans.internal/3445008888 (auto)

drew_infra: can you paste the examples? I can add redirect mappings into docs-redirects.yaml if we know the old ids.

marta_docs: snippet from the scan: `/docs/sdk/python.md#async-client` -> 404, `/docs/sdk/python.md#retry-policy` -> 404. I think headings were adjusted to match styleguide.

niko_eng: FWIW the Python SDK sample repo references `#async-client` from the README. We should either preserve old anchors or update the sample README. Prefer preserving via explicit anchors for stability.

marta_docs: agreed. I'll open a small PR that adds explicit HTML anchors in the python doc and a redirect mapping. Keeping changes tiny so we don't re-run the whole site build.

jenni: ping me for a quick CR when it's up. I'll do a fast pass.

qa-bot: Suggested checklist: add tests to docs/link-check (anchor mode), update docs-redirects.yaml, and add changelog entry.

drew_infra: After merge I can trigger a preview build and purge the staging cache for `/docs/sdk/python` path so the preview shows fixes immediately.

marta_docs: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5555 — title: "python-sdk-stable-anchors-and-redirects". Small note in PR about why we preserve old anchors for external references.

jenni: reviewed and left 1 nits comment; nothing blocking.

marta_docs: merged. Thanks all. @drew_infra please trigger preview purge; @niko_eng can you follow up on updating the sample repo to avoid dangling references next sprint?

drew_infra: Purge queued. Preview shows no more 404s. :tada:

niko_eng: Yep will schedule a one-line update to the sample README in next sprint. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
